mapper.select: SELECT schedule_no , class_id , notice_no , schedule_writer , schedule_category , schedule_title , start_date , end_date FROM academic_schedule ORDER BY schedule_no

SELECT schedule_no "id" , s.class_id , s.notice_no , schedule_writer , schedule_category "calendarId" , 'allday' "category" , schedule_title "title" , start_date "start" , end_date "end" , CASE WHEN n.NOTICE_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '게시판으로 이동' END AS "body" FROM academic_schedule s LEFT JOIN notice n ON s.NOTICE_NO = n.NOTICE_NO WHERE s.CLASS_ID = #{classId} and (start_date between #{start} and #{end} or end_date between #{start} and #{end})

SELECT schedule_no , class_id , notice_no , schedule_writer , schedule_category , schedule_title , start_date , end_date , (select notice_title from notice where notice_no = s.notice_no) as notice_title FROM academic_schedule s WHERE schedule_no = #{scheduleNo}
